minutes.title: Weekly platform sync
minutes.abstract: The team confirmed that release 4.2 is ready apart from the German locale, agreed a two-week on-call rotation after last Tuesday's night incident, and approved two additional GPU nodes for the sovereign transcription cluster.

topics.title: Release 4.2 readiness
topics.summary: Every runner is green and the only blocker is the German locale, where 47 billing strings are still untranslated and unreviewed.
key_points: Build and integration suites pass on all runners.
47 untranslated strings remain, all in the billing screens.
The release window on 12 June cannot be moved.

topics.title: On-call rotation and incident review
topics.summary: Last Tuesday's night incident showed that the weekly rotation concentrates fatigue and that hand-over notes are not written down.
key_points: The pager fired at 02:00 for a responder at the end of a full week.

topics.title: Transcription cluster capacity
topics.summary: Peak queue time exceeds ten minutes; two additional GPU nodes bring it back within the service target without leaving the data centre.
key_points: Queue time at peak is above the ten-minute target.

decisions.statement: Release 4.2 ships on 12 June with the German locale disabled.
decisions.rationale: The billing strings are neither translated nor proof-read, and the release window is fixed.

citations.speaker: Amara Okafor
citations.quote: Then we ship four point two on the twelfth of June with the German locale disabled.

decisions.statement: The on-call rotation moves to a two-week cycle from July.
decisions.rationale: A weekly cycle concentrates night work on a single responder.

citations.speaker: Amara Okafor
citations.quote: We move the rotation to a two-week cycle starting in July.

decisions.statement: Two additional GPU nodes are approved for the transcription cluster.

citations.speaker: Amara Okafor
citations.quote: Approved. Please draft the procurement request before the board meeting.

actions.description: Disable the German locale in the 4.2 release branch and open a translation ticket.

citations.speaker: Léa Fontaine
citations.quote: I will disable the locale in the release branch today.

actions.description: Circulate the incident review notes and the new hand-over template.

citations.speaker: Jonas Weber
citations.quote: I will write the review up and share the template.

actions.description: Draft the procurement request for the two GPU nodes.
Compare on-premises | cloud costs for the cluster before the board meeting.

open_questions.question: Do we need a second reviewer for the German locale before the next release?

citations.speaker: Léa Fontaine
citations.quote: Should a second reviewer sign off the locale?

open_questions.question: Who owns the monthly cost report once the cluster is live?
